environment.description: Poly Haven Dry Field 1k (Greg Zaal, CC0), PMREM for material lighting/reflection only. Procedural sky and authored painted skyline remain visible. Local assets are awaited before readiness.

effects.implementation: CC0 1k scanned mud/grass/bark/mossed stone diffuse and GL-normal maps, sRGB only for diffuse, metre UVs, moderated scan luminance preserving literary palette. Fine alpha-tested layered leaf sprigs and crooked branching; no spherical foliage cores.
Camera-local directional shadow map with a warm key behind experiential left and cool hemisphere fill.
Depth fog plus progressively flatter and bluer painted hill layers.
Official EffectComposer / RenderPass / OutputPass / ShaderPass(FXAAShader), ACES filmic color-managed output. FXAA after sRGB output. No MSAA allocation.
Globally identified 32m atmosphere tiles, pure equal-time CPU poses and fixed bounded buffers (<=350); water shader shares production clock. No particle shader motion or origin-based reseeding.

Assessed official GTAOPass; deferred because its MeshNormalMaterial override ignores fine alpha foliage and adds three full-screen targets plus normal geometry pass. Preserve leaf cutouts and budget instead of adding opaque-card halos. No SSR/SSGI/HBAO claim.

User-gesture Sound on/off control; local synthesized wind, leaves and stream. Canopy low-pass/gain attenuation. Audio context suspended on pause/hidden/retained page/context loss and closed on teardown. Default off.

weather.reducedMotion: Reduce drift amplitude and speed, never erase atmospheric details. No camera bob or automatic camera animation.
